articles.abstract_en: We use simulations of a simple learning model to predict cooperation rates in the experimental play of the indefinitely repeated prisoner’s dilemma. We suppose that learning and the game parameters only influence play in the initial round of each supergame, and that after these rounds, play depends only on the outcome of the previous round. We find that our model predicts out-of-sample cooperation at least as well as models with more parameters and harder-to-interpret machine learning algorithms. Our results let us predict the effect of session length and help explain past findings on the role of strategic uncertainty. (JEL C57, C72, C73, D83, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个简单学习模型的模拟来预测无限重复囚徒困境实验中的合作率。我们假设学习和博弈参数仅影响每个超级博弈初始轮次的博弈，而在这些轮次之后，博弈仅取决于上一轮的结果。我们发现，我们的模型在样本外预测合作方面至少与具有更多参数和更难解释的机器学习算法一样好。我们的结果使我们能够预测会话时长的影响，并有助于解释过去关于策略不确定性作用的研究发现。(JEL C57, C72, C73, D83, D91)

articles.title_cn: 社会连通性与信息市场
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates information quality in a simple model of socially connected information markets. Suppliers’ payoffs derive from the fraction of consumers who see their stories. Consumers prefer to share and act only on high-quality information. Quality is endogenous and highest when social connectedness is neither too high nor too low. In highly connected markets, low-quality stories are widely seen, giving suppliers little incentive to invest in quality. Increasing the volume of misinformation and increasing consumers’ costs of tuning in to suppliers’ broadcasts can each increase equilibrium information quality. (JEL D11, D82, D83, L82, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在一个社会连通性信息市场的简单模型中研究信息质量。供应商的收益来源于看到其报道的消费者比例。消费者倾向于只分享和依据高质量信息行事。质量是内生的，当社会连通性既不过高也不过低时，质量最高。在高度连通的市场中，低质量报道被广泛看到，这使供应商缺乏投资于质量的激励。增加错误信息的数量以及增加消费者收听供应商广播的成本，均能提高均衡信息质量。（JEL D11, D82, D83, L82, Z13）

articles.title_en: Innovation in Decentralized Markets: Technology versus Synthetic Products
articles.title_cn: 分散市场中的创新：技术对合成产品
articles.abstract_en: Advances in market-clearing technology for multiple assets and synthetic products present alternative ways to leverage complementarities and substitutabilites in asset payoffs. This paper compares their equilibrium and welfare effects. In competitive markets, either instrument can mimic the efficient design. When traders have price impact, however, synthetic products and market-clearing technology provide separate instruments for impacting markets’ performance and can generate synergies or trade-offs. Neither instrument can generally reproduce the other’s payoffs state by state. Moreover, innovation in market clearing renders additional synthetic products nonredundant. Our analysis points to the advantages of each type of innovation while also exposing potential risks. (JEL D44, D47, G11, G12, G13, O31)
articles.abstract_cn: 多资产和市场清算技术的进步以及合成产品为利用资产收益中的互补性和替代性提供了替代途径。本文比较了它们的均衡和福利效应。在竞争市场中，任何一种工具都可以模仿有效设计。然而，当交易者具有价格影响时，合成产品和市场清算技术为影响市场绩效提供了独立的工具，并可能产生协同效应或权衡。一般来说，任何一种工具都无法在状态上复制另一种工具的收益。此外，市场清算的创新使得额外的合成产品变得非冗余。我们的分析指出了每种创新的优势，同时也暴露了潜在的风险。(JEL D44, D47, G11, G12, G13, O31)

articles.title_en: Exit Dilemma: The Role of Private Learning on Firm Survival
articles.title_cn: 退出困境：私人学习对企业生存的作用
articles.abstract_en: We study the exit of duopolists from a stochastically declining market. Firms privately learn about the market conditions from observing the stochastic arrival of customers, while exit decisions are publicly observed. A larger firm is more likely to have customers and hence has better information about the market conditions. We provide sufficient conditions for either the smaller or the larger firm to be the first to exit in the unique equilibrium. Because of observational learning, exiting may be a firm's dominant action since continuing operation would bring too optimistic news to the rival, leading it to further postpone its exit. (JEL D21, D43, D83, L21, L25)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了双寡头从随机衰退的市场中退出的问题。企业通过观察顾客的随机到达来私下了解市场状况，而退出决策则是公开观察到的。较大的企业更有可能拥有顾客，因此对市场状况拥有更好的信息。我们提供了在唯一均衡中较小或较大企业首先退出的充分条件。由于观察学习，退出可能是企业的占优行动，因为继续经营会给竞争对手带来过于乐观的信息，导致其进一步推迟退出。（JEL D21, D43, D83, L21, L25）

articles.abstract_en: We provide two nested models of random reference-dependent choice in which the reference point is endogenously determined by random processes. Random choice behavior is due to random reference points, even though, from the decision-maker’s viewpoint, choices are deterministic. Through a revealed preference exercise, we establish when and how one can identify the reference-dependent preferences and the random reference rule from observed choice data. We also present behavioral postulates that characterize the empirical content of our models. Lastly, we investigate an application of our model to Bertrand competition with differentiated products. (JEL D11, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了两个嵌套的随机参考依赖选择模型，其中参考点由随机过程内生决定。随机选择行为源于随机参考点，尽管从决策者的角度来看，选择是确定性的。通过显示性偏好分析，我们确定了何时以及如何从观察到的选择数据中识别参考依赖偏好和随机参考规则。我们还提出了刻画我们模型经验内容的行为公理。最后，我们研究了我们的模型在差异化产品伯特兰竞争中的应用。（JEL D11, D91）

articles.title_en: Weighted Utility and Optimism/Pessimism: A Decision-Theoretic Foundation of Various Stochastic Dominance Orders
articles.title_cn: 加权效用与乐观/悲观：各种随机占优序的决策理论基础
articles.abstract_en: We show that a probability distribution likelihood ratio dominates another distribution if and only if, for every weighted utility function, the former is preferred over the latter. Likewise, a probability distribution hazard rate (or reverse hazard rate) dominates another distribution if and only if, the former is preferred by every optimistic (or pessimistic) decision maker. (JEL D11, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们证明，一个概率分布的似然比占优于另一个分布，当且仅当对于每一个加权效用函数，前者都优于后者。同样地，一个概率分布的失效率（或逆失效率）占优于另一个分布，当且仅当前者被每一个乐观（或悲观）决策者所偏好。（JEL D11, D83）

articles.title_en: Coordination in the Fight against Collusion
articles.abstract_en: While antitrust authorities strive to detect, prosecute, and thereby deter collusive conduct, entities harmed by that conduct are also advised to pursue their own strategies to deter collusion. The implications of such delegation of deterrence have largely been ignored, however. In a procurement context, we find that buyers may prefer to accommodate rather than deter collusion among their suppliers. We also show that a multimarket buyer, such as a centralized procurement authority, may optimally deter collusion when multiple independent buyers would not, consistent with the view that “large” buyers are less susceptible to collusion. (JEL D21, D43, D44, L12, L14)
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管反垄断机构努力侦查、起诉并以此威慑合谋行为，但受该行为损害的实体也被建议采取自己的策略来威慑合谋。然而，这种威慑委托的含义在很大程度上被忽视了。在采购情境中，我们发现买方可能更倾向于容忍而非威慑其供应商之间的合谋。我们还表明，一个多市场买方，如集中采购机构，在多个独立买方不会威慑合谋的情况下，可能会最优地威慑合谋，这与“大型”买方不易受合谋影响的观点一致。(JEL D21, D43, D44, L12, L14)

articles.title_en: Constructive versus Toxic Argumentation in Debates
articles.title_cn: 辩论中的建设性与有害性论证
articles.abstract_en: Two debaters address an audience by sequentially choosing their information strategies. We compare the setting where the second mover reveals additional information (constructive argumentation) with the setting where the second mover obfuscates the first mover’s information (toxic argumentation). We reframe both settings as constrained optimization of the first mover. We show that when the preferences are zero-sum or risk-neutral, constructive debates reveal the state, while toxic debates are completely uninformative. Moreover, constructive debates reveal the state under the assumption on preferences that capture autocratic regimes, whereas toxic debates are completely uninformative under the assumption on preferences that capture democratic regimes. (JEL D72, D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 两位辩手通过依次选择其信息策略来面向听众发言。我们比较了第二行动者揭示额外信息（建设性论证）与第二行动者混淆第一行动者信息（有害性论证）这两种情形。我们将这两种情形重新表述为第一行动者的约束优化问题。我们证明，当偏好是零和或风险中性时，建设性辩论揭示状态，而有害性辩论则完全无信息量。此外，在捕捉专制政权的偏好假设下，建设性辩论揭示状态，而在捕捉民主政权的偏好假设下，有害性辩论则完全无信息量。（JEL D72, D82, D83）

articles.title_cn: 当买方竞争时的反竞争捆绑
articles.abstract_en: We study the profitability of bundling by an upstream firm that licenses technologies to downstream competitors and that faces competition for one of its technologies. In an otherwise standard “ Chicago-style” model, the existence of downstream competition can make inefficient bundling profitable. Forcing downstream firms to use an inefficient technology reassures each one that it will face weak competition. This allows the upstream firm to extract more profit through its monopolized technology. A similar logic can make it profitable to degrade interoperability with rival technologies, even without foreclosing competition. Bundling is most profitable when downstream competition is intense and technologies complementary. (JEL D21, D24, D43, D45, G34, L24)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个上游公司向下游竞争对手授权技术并面临其一项技术竞争时捆绑销售的盈利能力。在一个其他方面标准的“芝加哥式”模型中，下游竞争的存在可以使无效率的捆绑变得有利可图。迫使下游公司使用无效率的技术使每家公司都确信它将面临较弱的竞争。这使得上游公司能够通过其垄断技术提取更多利润。类似的逻辑可以使与竞争性技术的互操作性降级变得有利可图，即使没有排挤竞争。当下游竞争激烈且技术互补时，捆绑销售最为有利可图。(JEL D21, D24, D43, D45, G34, L24)

articles.abstract_en: Most prosocial decisions involve intertemporal trade-offs. Yet, the timing of prosocial utility flows is ambiguous and bypassed by most models of other-regarding preferences. We study the behavioral implications of the time structure of prosocial utility, leveraging a conceptual distinction between consequence-dated and choice-dated utility flows. We conduct a high-stakes donation experiment that comprehensively characterizes discounting behavior in self–other tradeoffs and allows us to identify different prosocial motives from their distinct time profiles. Our data can only be explained by a combination of choice- and consequence-dated prosocial utility. Both motives are pervasive and negatively correlated at the individual level. (JEL D15, D64, D91, I12, L31)
articles.abstract_cn: 大多数亲社会决策涉及跨期权衡。然而，亲社会效用流的时间结构尚不明确，且被大多数利他偏好模型所忽略。我们利用结果日期与选择日期效用流之间的概念区分，研究亲社会效用时间结构的行为含义。我们进行了一项高额捐赠实验，全面刻画了自我-他人权衡中的贴现行为，并使我们能够根据不同的时间特征识别不同的亲社会动机。我们的数据只能通过选择日期和结果日期的亲社会效用的组合来解释。这两种动机普遍存在，且在个体层面呈负相关。（JEL D15, D64, D91, I12, L31）
